Package renderer

Class SimpleRayTracer

java.lang.Object
renderer.RayTracerBase
renderer.SimpleRayTracer
public class SimpleRayTracer extends RayTracerBase
A basic ray tracer that computes the color of the closest intersection point of a ray with scene geometries.

      public Color traceRay(Ray ray)
      Traces a ray through the scene and determines the resulting color. If no intersection is found, returns the background color.
      Specified by:
      traceRay in class RayTracerBase
      Parameters:
      ray - the ray to trace through the scene
      Returns:
